episodes.title: Daydream
episodes.summary: Amid financial strife, Abraham Quintanilla prioritizes his 8-year-old daughter Selena's musical talent and has her start a band with her siblings.

episodes.title: Dame Un Beso
episodes.summary: Brother AB struggles to find Selena a song for a new single, while Abraham tries to convince a music executive to produce a record with the band.

episodes.title: And the Winner is...
episodes.summary: Selena is nominated for Female Vocalist of the Year at the Tejano Music Awards. The band travels to Matamoros, Mexico, for an important performance.

episodes.title: Opening Act
episodes.summary: Selena y Los Dinos embark on a strenuous cross-country music tour, which puts strain on the singer's vocal cords, so the band searches for a solution.

episodes.title: Dulce Amor
episodes.summary: Abraham weighs two offers from major record labels. As Selena and her band garner more attention, a dashing new guitarist joins the family.

episodes.title: My Love
episodes.summary: While preparing the new album, the Quintanilla family clashes with the record label's decisions, especially when it comes to Selena's fashion style.

episodes.title: Fideo
episodes.summary: Sister Suzette becomes concerned when sparks fly between Selena and the new guitarist, Chris. Meanwhile, AB is under pressure to write new songs.

episodes.title: Gold Rush
episodes.summary: Selena celebrates her growing successes — including an album going gold — but fights to get an English album produced. Suzette meets someone new.

episodes.title: Qué Creías
episodes.summary: Selena feels conflicted about her secret relationship with Chris. Meanwhile, AB finds inspiration in a memory of a plastic flower and lost love.

episodes.title: Como la Flor
episodes.summary: Distraught by her upcoming tour and the thought of being separated from Chris, Selena makes a dramatic, life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Enter My World
episodes.summary: During the band's Mexico tour, Verónica Castro presses Selena about her love life. The singer struggles with whether to tell her fans about Chris.

episodes.title: The Call
episodes.summary: Perfectionist A.B. faces challenges trying to record new music for the album. Selena attempts to convince her family she can handle opening a boutique.

episodes.title: Itty Bitty Bubbles
episodes.summary: Selena writes a new song while worrying about going solo for her English album. Suzette plans her wedding. Yolanda offers to help with the boutique.

episodes.title: Oh No
episodes.summary: As Selena's career gains momentum, she struggles to juggle all of her business obligations and her parents caution her not to forget about her family.

episodes.title: Lo más bello
episodes.summary: When "Live!" receives a Grammy nomination, a star-struck Selena and Suzette attend the awards show. Ricky pens lyrics about unrequited love.

episodes.title: Si una vez
episodes.summary: Selena's confidence plummets when her label suggests she hire a vocal coach. To make matters worse, the singer feels distanced from Chris.

episodes.title: Astrodome
episodes.summary: Yolanda pleads her innocence as the accusations against her continue to pile up. Abraham investigates. Selena performs to a sold-out Astrodome.

episodes.title: When All the World is Sleeping
episodes.summary: Selena and Chris plan their future family. A distraught Yolanda asks for the singer's help and a grim tragedy occurs. "Dreaming of You" is released.
